content.comment_body: Hello experts, I have 22 messages that need to be shown using 5 digital inputs as binary code. Is it possible with [product_name] to use these inputs and decode them for message display?
Hello, You can use several analog multiplexers to create values from 0 to 22. Then, by adding analog threshold triggers, you can activate the corresponding message block as needed. Regards
